{{Quote|Tatooine! We are the Double Sunburns, are you ready to feel the heat?! One, two, one, two, three...|Double Sunburns strummer, announcing the performance to the public in the cantina.|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
The '''Double Sunburns''' were a [[Band/Legends|band]] active around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Lead by two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] musicians: a blue-skinned male [[strummer]] and a green-skinned female vocalist, the band also consisted of a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo]] players and a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargonist]].<ref name="Comeback" /> At one point they had a performance called "The Sophomore Album" scheduled in the [[Junix's Joint|Anchorhead cantina]], but on route their land-speeder got overheated and as they stopped, the musicians were attacked by [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] which nearly caused them to miss their gig. After some republic-aligned passers‑by helped them to fix the speeders and recover their music equipment, including Nalargon Keys and Kloo Horn Reeds,<ref name="Debut">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Road Gig: The Debut|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> the band successfully made it to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. There they used [[GNK power droid/Legends|Ad-Gonk droids]] to advertise their performance,<ref name="Sophomore" /> before giving a show in Anchorhead cantina,<ref name="Comeback" /> temporarily replacing on stage [[Load Lifters]].<ref name="Junix">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Junix's Joint]]|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Double Sunburns were introduced in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in a 3-part dynamic encounter quest-chain "Road Gig" accessible only to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] players.
